body: We’ve found that self-play allows simulated AIs to discover physical skills like tackling, ducking, faking, kicking, catching, and diving for the ball, without explicitly designing an environment with these skills in mind. Self-play ensures that the environment is always the right difficulty for an AI to improve. Taken alongside our Dota 2 self-play results, we have increasing confidence that self-play will be a core part of powerful AI systems in the future.
summaryZh: OpenAI通过研究发现，自我博弈（Self-play）机制能使模拟AI在无需人工干预的情况下，自动习得包括擒抱、假动作、踢球等复杂物理技能。该方法确保了训练环境始终保持适宜的难度，从而推动AI性能持续提升，被视为构建未来高性能AI系统的核心范式。
